```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""

jobs:
  create-release:
    name: Create Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate version
        run: |
          TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
          CARGO_VERSION=$(grep '^version =' Cargo.toml | head -n1 | cut -d'"' -f2)
          if [[ "$TAG_VERSION" != "v$CARGO_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Tag version ($TAG_VERSION) does not match Cargo.toml version ($CARGO_VERSION)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create Release
        id: create_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          draft: true
          name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          generate_release_notes: true

  build-cli:
    name: Build CLI (${{ matrix.target }} - ${{ matrix.features }})
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Linux x86_64
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: cpu
            artifact_name: cake-linux-x86_64-cpu
            cross: false
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: cuda-11-8
            artifact_name: cake-linux-x86_64-cuda-11-8
            cross: false
            cuda_version: "11.8.0"
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: cuda-12-4
            artifact_name: cake-linux-x86_64-cuda-12-4
            cross: false
            cuda_version: "12.4.0"
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: cuda-13-0
            artifact_name: cake-linux-x86_64-cuda-13-0
            cross: false
            cuda_version: "13.0.0"
          # Linux aarch64
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: cpu
            artifact_name: cake-linux-aarch64-cpu
            cross: true
          # macOS arm64
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            features: metal
            artifact_name: cake-macos-arm64-metal
            cross: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install lld (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.cross == false
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lld

      - name: Install CUDA Toolkit
        if: matrix.cuda_version
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.14
        with:
          cuda: ${{ matrix.cuda_version }}
          method: network

      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.cross
        run: |
          curl -sSL https://github.com/cross-rs/cross/releases/download/v0.2.5/cross-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv cross /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Build
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: true
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features ${{ matrix.features }}
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --features ${{ matrix.features }}
          fi

      - name: Package
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake dist/
          cd dist
          tar -czf ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.tar.gz cake
          sha256sum ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.tar.gz > ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.sha256

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}
          path: dist/

  build-mobile:
    name: Build Mobile (${{ matrix.target }})
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Android aarch64
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: aarch64-linux-android
            artifact_name: cake-mobile-android-aarch64
            cross: true
            lib_name: libcake_mobile.so
          # iOS arm64
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-ios
            artifact_name: cake-mobile-ios-arm64
            cross: false
            lib_name: libcake_mobile.a

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.cross
        run: |
          curl -sSL https://github.com/cross-rs/cross/releases/download/v0.2.5/cross-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv cross /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Build
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: true
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} -p cake-mobile
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} -p cake-mobile
          fi

      - name: Package
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ matrix.lib_name }} dist/
          cd dist
          tar -czf ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.tar.gz ${{ matrix.lib_name }}
          sha256sum ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.tar.gz > ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}.sha256

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}
          path: dist/

  upload-release:
    name: Upload Release Assets
    needs: [create-release, build-cli, build-mobile]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: Upload to Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          for dir in artifacts/*/; do
            if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
              for file in "$dir"*; do
                if [ -f "$file" ]; then
                  gh release upload "$TAG_NAME" "$file" --clobber
                fi
              done
            fi
          done
```
